rationale: The frozen 13-feature Model C architecture, trained natively on ES 2020-2023 with the NQ parent's own direction-specific hyperparameters and no tuning, discriminates an imminent prevailing 1m regime flip within 180s on untouched ES 2024, in BOTH directions.
